==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|interpretacioun}}, from the {{der|en|xno|-}} form of {{der|en|fro|interpretacion}}, from {{der|en|la|interpretātiō}}, noun of action from {{m|la|interpretor||to explain, expound, interpret, understand, conclude, infer, comprehend}}. Morphologically {{suffix|en|interpret|ation}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˌtɜːpɹəˈteɪʃən/|a=RP}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-interpretation.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˌtɝpɹəˈteɪʃən/|a=GA,CA}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-interpretation.wav|a=Texas}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˌtɜːpɹəˈtæɪʃən/|a=AU}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=5}}
* {{hyph|en|in|ter|pre|ta|tion}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|countable}} An act of [[interpret]]ing or explaining something unclear; a [[translation]]; a [[version]]. <!--act-->
#: {{syn|en|gloss}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''interpretation''' of a dream, or of an enigma}}
#: {{ux|en|The '''interpretation''' of the rules}}
# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[sense]] given by an [[interpreter]]; an [[exposition]] or [[explanation]] given; meaning. <!--result-->
#: {{syn|en|reading}}
#: {{ux|en|Commentators give various '''interpretations''' of the same passage of Scripture.}}
# {{senseid|en|translation studies}} {{lb|en|uncountable|linguistics|translation studies}} The [[discipline]] or [[study]] of [[translate|translating]] one spoken or [[sign]]ed language into another (as opposed to [[translation]], which concerns itself with written language).
#* '''1994''', Richard K. Seymour, University of Hawaii at Manoa. ''Translation and Interpreting: Bridging East and West : Selected Conference Papers'', University of Hawaii Press ({{ISBN|9780824816032}}), page 11
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2002|author=Alessandra Riccardi|title=Translation Studies: Perspectives on an Emerging Discipline|publisher=Cambridge University Press|isbn=9780521817318|page=90
|passage='''Interpretation''' studies is a young discipline, much younger than translation studies, and it cannot claim a long tradition and history of reflexions {{sic}} and studies.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2013|author=Sana Loue|title=Handbook of Immigrant Health|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=9781489919366|page=61
|passage=The most pervasive need of non-English-speaking immigrants and refugees is '''interpretation''' for every English transaction. '''Interpretation''' is needed in stores, schools, and job training, and it is of critical importance in health care.}}
#: {{syn|en|interpreting}}
#: {{hyponyms|en|simultaneous interpretation|consecutive interpretation}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} The power of explaining.<!--art, power, practice, profession-->
# {{lb|en|countable}} An artist's way of [[express]]ing [[thought]] or embodying a conception of nature through art.
# {{lb|en|countable}} An act or process of [[apply]]ing general [[principle]]s or [[formula]]e to the explanation of the results obtained in special cases.
# {{lb|en|countable|physics}} An [[approximation]] that allows aspects of a mathematical theory to be discussed in ordinary language.<!--specialization of previous?-->
# {{lb|en|countable|logic|model theory}} An [[assignment]] of a [[truth value]] to each propositional symbol of a [[propositional calculus]].
# {{short for|en|heritage interpretation}}
